headline: Returns to profit as license sales surge, margins expand
summary_short: Net sales rose 22% year-over-year to SEK 254.5 million, with adjusted EBIT margin reaching the company's 15% long-term target and the company swinging to a SEK 20.8 million net profit versus a year-ago loss.
summary_long: Q2 2026 net sales were SEK 254.5 million, up 22% year-over-year (25% in local currency), as license revenue jumped to SEK 84.8 million (33% of sales, from 28%). Gross margin expanded to 69% from 65%, and the company swung to an EBIT of SEK 32.7 million from a SEK 22.4 million loss a year earlier, with adjusted EBIT margin reaching its 15% long-term target. Net income was SEK 20.8 million (EPS SEK 0.41) versus a year-ago loss. Cash rose to SEK 658.4 million from SEK 610.2 million. Management said stronger-than-expected license sales narrowed the 2026 revenue hit from Intuitive's cancelled MOU to below the previously flagged SEK 60-90 million range.
confidence_notes: Shard's Yahoo-sourced eps_usd (SEK 0.4793, from earningsChart) diverges from the company's own reported Q2 2026 EPS of SEK 0.41 in the interim report; the filing figure was used for the KPI table as the more authoritative same-basis number. The release discloses only y/y and H1 comparisons (no standalone Q1 2026 figures), so all KPI deltas here are y/y, not q/q. Management's long-term FY2027 targets (10-15% annual growth, adjusted EBIT margin of at least 15%) were referenced in earnings-call coverage but could not be confirmed verbatim in the primary release within the fetch budget, so they were not written to the guidance array.

drivers.explanation: Reported growth of 22% versus 25% in local currencies implies a modest FX translation headwind on international revenue, per the company's own reported vs. local-currency growth figures.
Stronger-than-expected license sales narrowed the 2026 revenue impact from Intuitive's cancelled MOU to less than the previously indicated SEK 60-90 million range.

Release attributes the return to profit mainly to license-revenue strength and gross-margin expansion, with adjusted EBIT margin reaching the company's 15% long-term target ahead of the 2027 timeline previously flagged.
